name: 68118 · Omaha, NE
findings: ZIP 68118 (Omaha) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68118 (Omaha) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 68118 (Omaha) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).
